name: Torvo
summary: Torvo is defined by an ultra white travertine top in a soft matte finish, offering a clean, sculptural elegance with subtle natural texture. The supporting plate and fiberglass leg are coated in a rich olive green high gloss, adding a vivid, contemporary contrast that lifts the whole design. The result is a piece with crisp modern character and a confidently elevated presence. Top in ultra white travertine matte finishes; Supporting plate and fiberglass leg in Olive Green high-gloss paint. 60×46
